verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents built-in recruiting reports that can be cut by sources, departments, jobs, and offers, plus advanced and AI-powered report filtering. Its Offer Forecast tracks roles against target offer acceptances. Together these cover source effectiveness and offer data per role and team, but the evidence never names stage-conversion or time-to-hire metrics. Missing for 10: explicit stage-conversion/funnel reporting, time-to-hire metrics, explicit offer-accept rate reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I see the hiring funnel honestly — stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and offer-accept rates per role and team

citations.quote: Build recruiting reports by candidates, sources, departments, jobs, offices, offers, openings, custom fields and more
Greenhouse Offer Forecast – Leverage machine learning to ensure roles are on track based on target offer acceptances and start dates
Advanced data filtering – Make filtering data straightforward and streamlined with intuitive workflows and live report previews
